Chapter:
Installing and loading the package The package can be downloaded as a .tar.gz archive from https://gap-packages.github.io/sglppow/
Then tar -zxvf sglppow-&VERSION;.tar.gz produces a directory sglppow-&VERSION;. This should be moved into the pkg directory of a GAP installation.
The package is set up so that after loading it into GAP with LoadPackage("sglppow"); the full functionality of the package is available.
